description: Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Only pass a public_id obtained from eacc_get_hot_topics links.story; never invent or infer IDs.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

public_id.description: Opaque story public ID. Obtain it from the final path segment of eacc_get_hot_topics links.story; never guess it.

report_limit.description: Maximum number of timeline reports, from 1 to 50.

name: eacc_get_story
